The brand's history began in 2019 when Otabek Umarov, head of the Triathlon Federation of Uzbekistan, designed a logo based on global sports icons. The design incorporated various sports in outline form, symbolizing the philosophy of courage and willpower, with the number 7 representing these values. Initially, the logo was freely used by sports organizations and equipment manufacturers, which helped the brand gain popularity among athletes and fans. In 2020, Berkeley Square Investments, a Dubai corporation, conducted market research in Uzbekistan and discovered the brand's strong recognition and loyalty. Through its representative Urban Hayot, the company negotiated with the logo's creator, leading to a five-year licensing agreement with Urban Hayot LLC. The London Institute of Identity (INSTID) and Tashkent agency GRANDPR collaborated to develop the brand '7SABER,' which was officially launched on June 25, 2021.
